verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated IDE review surface: review code in the IDE before pushing (docs-24), with instant feedback in VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and other VS Code-based IDEs (docs-25). It reviews uncommitted changes with no pull request required and applies fixes instantly (docs-40). The CLI offers a parallel pre-commit path (docs-2). Missing for 10: evidence that the IDE review matches the PR review (same rules, path instructions and learnings), coverage of non-VS Code IDEs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the IDE extension.
